name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. It must jump to the main content with one keystroke, bypassing repetitive navigation. This fixes keyboard navigation for screen reader users and anyone who can’t use a mouse. The trade-off: it takes up a little space at the top, but that’s negligible compared to the usability gain.

name: Reader
text: The real risk isn’t layout shift—it’s the flash of the skip link when it appears, which can distract screen-reader users mid-page. A better alternative: hide the skip link by default, then reveal it only when focus arrives via keyboard. Settle it by testing with a screen reader—if the flash is gone and keyboard users still reach the main content in one keystroke, adopt the hidden version.
